stories.title: Palestijnse leider Abbas stelt verkiezingen van november met een jaar uit

en.title: Palestinian leader Abbas postpones November elections by one year
en.summary: President Mahmoud Abbas of the Palestinian Authority has canceled parliamentary elections scheduled for next month, moving them to September of the following year. Abbas attributed the postponement to Israeli military operations in Palestinian territories.

stories.title: Palestijnse leider Abbas verplaatst verkiezingen naar september 2027

en.title: Palestinian leader Abbas moves elections to September 2027
en.summary: Palestinian leader Abbas has postponed elections to September 2027.

stories.title: Spookrijder omgekomen bij ongeluk op A2, weg urenlang dicht

en.title: Wrong-way driver dies in accident on A2, road closed for hours
en.summary: A wrong-way driver died in a collision on the A2 highway near Breukelen after hitting two other vehicles. One other driver was injured in the multi-vehicle crash, which caused the highway to close for an extended period.

stories.title: Spookrijder omgekomen bij ongeval op A2, weg richting Amsterdam nog dicht

en.title: Wrong-way driver dies in accident on A2, road toward Amsterdam still closed
en.summary: A wrong-way driver died in a crash on the A2 highway between Utrecht and Amsterdam involving three vehicles, with multiple people injured.

stories.title: Marianne Vos behaalt vijftiende wereldtitel in Australië, haar tweede op een onverharde weg

en.title: Marianne Vos achieves fifteenth world title in Australia, her second on unpaved road
en.summary: Marianne Vos won her fifteenth world championship title in Australia on Saturday, becoming world champion in gravel cycling for the second time in her career.

stories.title: Geen treinen tussen Rotterdam en Delft door brandstichting bij spoorbrug

en.title: No trains between Rotterdam and Delft due to arson at railroad bridge
en.summary: Train service between Rotterdam Centraal and Delft Campus stations was suspended following a fire at a railroad bridge caused by arson.

stories.title: Storing bij KPN opgelost, universitaire ziekenhuizen weer bereikbaar

en.title: KPN outage resolved, university hospitals reachable again
en.summary: A telecommunications outage at KPN affected business customers and several university hospitals for hours until being resolved around 2 p.m. The disruption was caused by a cooling system failure at a network facility.

stories.title: Geen treinverkeer op spoor tussen Rotterdam en Delft door brandstichting

en.title: No train traffic on track between Rotterdam and Delft due to arson
en.summary: A fire at a railroad bridge halted train service between Rotterdam Centraal and Delft Campus throughout Saturday, with authorities finding no immediate connection to recent rail sabotage incidents.

stories.title: Landelijke storing bij KPN verholpen, ziekenhuizen weer goed bereikbaar

en.title: Nationwide KPN outage resolved, hospitals accessible again
en.summary: A nationwide telephone outage at KPN on Saturday disrupted service for business customers and several university hospitals, including Utrecht and Maastricht medical centers, before being fixed.

stories.title: Geëmotioneerde Marianne Vos (39) pakt bij WK gravel haar vijftiende wereldtitel

en.title: Emotional Marianne Vos (39) claims her fifteenth world title at gravel world championships
en.summary: Marianne Vos won her fifteenth world championship title on Saturday at the gravel cycling world championships, achieving her second victory in this discipline.

stories.title: Brandstichting bij het spoor, geen treinen tussen Rotterdam en Delft

en.title: Arson at railway line, no trains between Rotterdam and Delft
en.summary: A fire was deliberately set at a railway bridge near Rotterdam-Delfshaven, causing train services to be suspended between Rotterdam Centraal and Delft Campus stations for the entire day. Authorities are investigating whether the incident constitutes sabotage.

stories.title: Hele dag geen treinen tussen Rotterdam en Delft door brandstichting bij spoor

en.title: All day no trains between Rotterdam and Delft due to arson at railway
en.summary: Train services between Rotterdam and Delft are suspended on Saturday following arson at the Delfshaven railway bridge, with disruptions expected to continue until the end of regular service hours.
